sources.title: Kimi K3: Benchmarks, Pricing & Review — Moonshot's 2.8T Frontier ...
sources.snippet: Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's flagship model, released on 16 July 2026: a 2.8-trillion-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts reasoning model with a 1-million-token context window and native vision. It is the highest-ranked Chinese model ever on independent testing — fourth on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8.
